text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Yaeno Muteki...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where Yaeno Muteki's gaze hastily darted was a crane game filled with plushies styled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is not a matter of wanting it or not;
it is something that must not be possessed.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I were ever to obtain it,
if I were ever to hold it in my arms, I...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Kh... Those round, innocent eyes... Must protect...!
choice_data_list: Then I'll get it and keep it safe for you

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To hold it in my own hands in order to protect it...
Indeed, that is one way of looking at it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer-dono.
I pray for your success...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
